svg.title: A smaller set of possible locations needs fewer bits
svg.desc: Three panels show the same 1,024 locations. Before a result all 1,024 candidates remain and entropy is 10 bits. After one equal binary split 512 remain and entropy is 9 bits. After ten equal binary splits one candidate remains and entropy is zero. Pale dots are ruled out; a circle highlights the final candidate. Remaining candidates are equally likely.

g.text: A smaller set of possible locations needs fewer bits
Each dot is one possible heavy-marble location.
